items.title: Cursor marketplace served malicious Claude Code extension to up to 5,000 users
facts: A maliciously modified version of the Anthropic.claude-code extension (versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 for Windows and MacOS) was available in the Cursor VS Code Extension Marketplace between about 2:27am PT and 1:35pm PT on October 29.
The extension was not developed by Anthropic and attempted to install a persistent SSH backdoor while collecting host and user information.
Cursor removed the malicious version, shut down the marketplace as a precaution, rebuilt it, and stated the incident impacted at most 5,000 users.

items.title: Anthropic renames Max plans to Max and Ultra, removes 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts
facts: Max 5x is renamed to Max and remains $100/month; Max 20x is renamed to Ultra and remains $200/month.
The 5-hour limit is being removed for verified Ultra accounts, starting with most existing subscribers; newer accounts keep a temporary limit until verified.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.314 adds write restrictions outside working directories and idle compaction in VS Code
facts: Added permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories so that Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode.
Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized for use on the next message if the prompt cache has expired.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.166.0 adds keyboard transcript navigation and GPT-6.1 Terra model support
facts: Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts.
Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs.
Added codex queue --resume to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message and codex doctor --network-only for diagnostics.

items.title: VS Code 1.144 centers on Agents window for managing AI agents across workspaces
facts: The Agents window lets you manage your agents across workspaces and environments from a single interface.
By default, agents are now powered by the Copilot harness.
New features include image generation in chat (preview) and experimental computer use letting agents work in desktop apps.

items.title: OpenCode v2.2.4 adds persistent desktop terminals and experimental artifacts
facts: Desktop terminals now belong to the session, survive server restarts with their scrollback, and stay synchronized with the TUI and other windows.
Enable experimental artifacts in opencode.json to let agents publish, update, and serve HTML or static artifacts.

items.title: Community discussion on GPT models appearing in Google Cloud quotas for potential Antigravity support
facts: GPT models recently appeared in the Quotas page in the Google Cloud Console.
The Antigravity lead says next week is a big shipping week.
